_comment: Service-factory standalone products whose SIGNED installer is mirrored into Apps/lib/ExeProducts on each publish, so EA_Dist ships it to the fleet as a quick-onboarding convenience. Driver for _mirror_service_factory_installers() in ________publish.py. SOURCE OF TRUTH for the product roster + slugs is the service-factory skill's references/service-registry.md (Slug column, byte-for-byte) — when a new product is registered there at Phase 7b, add a row HERE too. 'slug' is the exact enneadtab.com/<slug>/updates/ feed segment (NOT the repo name: KeynoteExporter's slug is 'keynote', OneDriveResolver's is 'one-drive-resolver'). 'installer' is the stable de-versioned target name (all-underscore, matches existing ExeProducts convention e.g. EnneadTab_For_Revit_Installer.exe); overwrite = keep-latest. EXCLUDED on purpose: WatchMe (no updater wired) and For-Indesign (UXP plugin, no NSIS installer, feed is latest.json).
